_comment: Hard gates for the structure-prediction panel. No ranking. A design passes if every gate that has a value on that row succeeds; a missing value skips that gate (e.g. catalytic_ok is not available until structure scoring). These gates do not require AMP-likeness, and they deliberately do NOT gate on net charge, hydrophobic moment or any cationic/amphipathic 'delivery proxy': cationic+amphipathic is the biophysical definition of a membrane-lytic AMP, so gating on it reimposes the AMP objective and preferentially discards good binders, which against NDM-5/KPC-3 are net acidic. Those descriptors are still computed and carried in the manifest as annotations. Length is the mini-binder range [50,100]; cys_count must be 0 because BoltzGen's own filter_cysteine was not active in the original run (protocol protein-anything) and 10/25 of the NDM5 panel carried a free cysteine.

catalytic_ok.reason: does not contact the catalytic core

length.reason: length outside [50, 100] (mini-binder range; was [12,45] AMP sizing)

no_free_cysteine.reason: contains a cysteine: unpaired Cys is a synthesis/oxidation/dimerisation liability

max_aa_fraction.reason: low-complexity: >40% of the sequence is a single amino acid
